India Accuses Pakistan of Spreading Lies at UN on Jammu and Kashmir

India on Friday accused Pakistan of using the United Nations to spread "lies and falsehoods" regarding Jammu and Kashmir. India urged Pakistan to address alleged human rights violations in territories under its control. The statement was made in response to Pakistan's remarks at the UN.
